Most crypto staking pays a single number. You lock tokens, you earn APR, you unlock. TTS staking does that \u2014 and adds a second reward layer most projects do not have: increased voting power inside the weekly Temptation Token rounds. Every tier of TTS staking gives both yield and a multiplier on every vote you cast.<\/p>

This post breaks down the five TTS staking tiers, the math behind the APR, and how the vote multiplier compounds your edge as a player.<\/p>

The Five TTS Staking Tiers<\/h3>

Tiers are evaluated at stake time. If TTS appreciates after you stake, your tier does not downgrade. Your locked TTS earns at the tier you qualified for when you committed.<\/p>

Why Two Reward Layers Matter<\/h3>

The basic APR is straightforward. $1,000 staked at the Diamond tier earns roughly $320 over twelve months at the published rate. Competitive but not extraordinary by DeFi standards.<\/p>

The second layer is where TTS staking becomes interesting. The vote multiplier means every TTS you vote with during a round counts as more than 1 TTS toward your top voter position. At the VIP tier, 100 TTS voted counts as 300 TTS toward the leaderboard. At Gold, 100 TTS counts as 150.<\/p>

For players actively trying to win the 35% top voter prize, this is decisive. A Gold-tier staker can outvote a non-staker spending 1.5x the TTS. A VIP-tier staker can outvote a non-staker spending 3x. TTS staking turns into a structural edge inside the game, not just a yield play.<\/p>

How TTS Staking Compounds the Win<\/h3>

Imagine two players both trying to win the top voter slot. Player A has not staked. Player B is in the Diamond tier with $1,000 in TTS staking.<\/p>

Both vote with 500 TTS in a single round.<\/p>

  • Player A's leaderboard position counts as 500 TTS<\/li>
  • Player B's leaderboard position counts as 1,000 TTS (2x multiplier)<\/li><\/ul>

    If Player B wins the top voter slot and the pool is 50,000 TTS, Player B takes 17,500 TTS as the prize. Their staked $1,000 worth of TTS earned them a multiple of itself in a single round, on top of accruing 32% APR in the background.<\/p>

    This is the mechanic that makes TTS staking different from passive farming. It is participation infrastructure. The more you stake, the more efficient your votes become.<\/p>

    How to Start TTS Staking<\/h3>

    The Staking tab inside app.temptationtoken.io shows live tier requirements in both USD and TTS at current Uniswap price. Connect your wallet, choose a tier, approve, and stake. The contract is deployed at 0xaA12B889Ebcc32037bb8684B18DF7ED09b2B30fc<\/code>.<\/p>

    Rewards accrue continuously. The vote multiplier applies automatically the next time you cast a vote \u2014 no manual claim, no separate signup. The voting contract reads your TTS staking balance and applies the corresponding multiplier in the same transaction.<\/p>

    Risk and Lock Considerations<\/h3>

    TTS staking carries the standard risks any token-locking arrangement carries. Token price can move against you. The longer you stake, the more exposure you have to TTS volatility. The published APR is paid in TTS, so its dollar value tracks the token.<\/p>

    That said, every TTS used to pay TTS staking rewards comes from the scheduled emissions documented on the trust page. The contract is the only entity that can mint or distribute rewards. The deployer wallet cannot inflate beyond the schedule.<\/p>

    Who TTS Staking Is Built For<\/h3>

    Three player types benefit most from TTS staking:<\/p>

    • Active voters<\/strong> who want a multiplier edge in weekly rounds<\/li>
    • Long-term holders<\/strong> who would hold TTS regardless and want the APR layered on top<\/li>
    • High-tier players<\/strong> who want VIP treatment, including the 3x multiplier and access to upcoming VIP-only round features<\/li><\/ul>

      If you are buying TTS only to vote occasionally, the basic 1x rate works fine. If you are serious about winning weekly, TTS staking is the lever that compounds every other decision you make.<\/p>
